# EPISODE: EP00 — Cornish Arsehole

=== ACT I — SCENE 1 — TOWN STREET ===
[Location: town_street]
[Character Dap: alone nearest camera, medium shot from the waist up, still pose, three-quarter view facing camera, smug face, mouth open talking, wearing a black turtleneck, at the town street]
Dap: [smug] I walk this street every morning. Nobody else appreciates it properly. [pause]

[Location: town_street]
[Character Dap: alone nearest camera, medium shot from the waist up, three-quarter view facing camera, looking straight into the camera, smug face, mouth open talking, wearing a black turtleneck, at the town street, after speaking he turns away and walks off towards the right of screen]
Dap: [smug] One does try to engage with the community. [pause] The community, regrettably, is composed almost entirely of people. [pause]

[Location: town_street]
[Action: Dap walks at a calm, natural pace along the footpath past the row of terraced houses and shopfronts, strict side profile, moving left to right, normal relaxed steps with arms swinging gently, chin raised slightly, smug and oblivious, wearing a black turtleneck.
